title: Implement Merkle tip hashing and tip-set verification
description:
Implement tip_hash(tips: &[Cid]) -> [u8;32]: sort tip CIDs lexicographically, concatenate, SHA2-256. Implement verify_entry(entry: &LogEntry, storage: &dyn LogStorage) -> Result<()>: check signature, check all parent_cids exist in storage, check HLC ordering relative to parents. Artifact: src/group_log/verify.rs.

Acceptance:
- tip_hash is deterministic regardless of insertion order
- verify_entry returns error if signature is invalid
- verify_entry returns error if any parent CID is missing
- verify_entry returns error if HLC is not greater than all parent HLCs
- Unit tests cover all error paths
